summary: This bill amends the Commodity Credit Corporation Charter Act to exclude crops used for biofuel production, and related infrastructure, from being considered an agricultural commodity under the Act.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Commodity Credit Corporation Charter Act to exclude crops used for biofuel from being considered an agricultural commodity. This change would likely reduce the scope of programs and subsidies administered by the CCC related to biofuel crops, potentially leading to a decrease in government spending in this area.
